investigation.likely_cause: The /data volume on the Subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is 100% full because /data/txlog_archive holds 8.5 GiB, and 8.5 GiB was written to 34 files in the last 15 minutes. This points to an archived transaction log catch-up run rather than database growth. The database cannot write (write errors on all schemas), so balance and bundle API errors, USSD gateway timeouts, failing synthetic USSD sessions in all cities, and SMS queue growth are downstream symptoms.
